test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

The company __do not broke__ the law at any time.
solution:
The correct answer is 'B'' i.e. "does not break" which corrects the verb tense and subject-verb agreement in the sentence..

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence uses the incorrect form "**do not broke," **which mixes present tense** "do not"** with past tense "**broke**" and is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **"The company"** is a singular noun, so we should use "does" instead of "do" to match the subject-verb agreement.
 
• Option 2 correctly uses the present tense "does not break" to match the subject **"The company"** and maintain the correct verb tense.
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 do not follow the correct verb tense or subject-verb agreement rules.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *The company does not break the law at any time.*
